name: coach-vision
//react: The two apps are on different React majors: the board is React 18, and
Next 15's App Router wants 19. npm hoists ONE of them to the root and nests
the other — and it also hoists `next` itself, which then resolves whatever
React is at the root. Left alone npm hoisted 18, so `next` and apps/web saw
different Reacts and every render died with 'Objects are not valid as a
React child' (two copies means two $$typeof symbols).
Declaring 19 here pins the hoisted copy to the one `next` must use; the
board's 18 nests under apps/board and is unaffected. Remove this only when
both apps are on the same major.
